subtitleNullable: 1sec snapshots of Bitcoin limit order book data from BitMex exchange
descriptionNullable:
### Overview

This dataset contains 1-second snapshots of the first 20 levels from the limit order book on BitMex exchange for Bitcoin perpetual contracts (XBTUSD).


### Content

The data set contains 2 full months of data, split into individual days (using UTC time). Date range is [January 2020, February 2020].


### ML Research

This is the dataset used in [Extending Deep Reinforcement Learning Frameworks in Cryptocurrency Market Making](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2004.06985.pdf).
